rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is not direct, including questions and routes.

example.english: You're being so indirect that I really can't tell what you want.
example.traditional: 你講嘢咁唔直接，我真係估唔到你想點。
example.jyutping: nei5 gong2 je5 gam3 m4 zik6 zip3 ngo5 zan1 hai6 gu2 m4 dou2 nei5 soeng2 dim2

rows.note: Use this for questions or remarks that approach the point indirectly instead of asking plainly.

example.english: You don't need to be so indirect—just ask me directly.
example.traditional: 你唔使拐彎抹角，直接問我啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gwaai2 waan1 mut3 gok3 zik6 zip3 man6 ngo5 laa1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a route or course that takes a winding or non-direct path.

example.english: This route is too indirect; it takes an extra hour to get to the airport.
example.traditional: 呢條路線太迂迴，去機場要多成個鐘。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 lou6 sin3 taai3 jyu1 wui4 heoi3 gei1 coeng4 jiu3 do1 seng4 go3 zung1
